requirement: walk-forward grading of the originated board
games_excluded: week 1 is never scored; a club with no prior game is skipped
leakage_control: A forecast for week w uses only weeks strictly less than w, including the home allowance, the margin spread and the league mean.

permutation.null: forecasts are shuffled across games; only the pairing is destroyed

sensitivity.home_allowance: fixed at 2.0 points (the older board's assumption)
reference: back the home club in every game, no model

strategies.name: Favoured side plus the same side again
strategies.rule: Both legs are the same event, so the slip is not a parlay at all. Published as a control to show what a dependence of 1.0 costs.
